reviewer: Codex repository review; not a configured DSH Agent invocation

decisions.authorProfile: dsh-lark (SDK adapter by default; Web settings are an additional surface)

coverageGaps: Author default dsh-lark SDK adapter and authenticated Feishu interaction have not been exercised by the smoke planes.
decision.summary: Node >=22.19 is a declared minimum; CI configures Node 22, not an explicit author preference. Default user setup is dsh-lark with the SDK adapter; Web is an additional declared settings client. The generic headless/Web checks do not cover the SDK workflow.

CI configures Node 22. README explicitly installs into --profile web; Web is justified by that instruction, not merely by the remote browser feature. Credential-dependent Cloudflare requests remain outside the smoke-test scope.
Exact manifest and setup require Node >=24; CI also configures 24. The author installs into Web for OAuth/settings. Real Google OAuth and model traffic require user credentials and are not exercised.

Manifest explicitly supports ^22.19 || >=24. CI configures 24, so prefer that declared test version while retaining 22 as a lower supported boundary, not as an author recommendation. The exact package declares a Web client.

Manifest supports ^22.19 || >=24; CI configures 24. The author names dsh-tui as the actual terminal profile. Browser-related feature descriptions do not make this a DSH Web client. Interactive model behavior requires an API key and is not covered.

Plugin declares >=20, but CI configures Node 22 and tests the Web profile; use that stronger repository signal. This is not proof that Node 20 is incompatible. Oversized READMEs are explicitly omitted from bounded evidence; native node-pty build approval is not pre-granted.

decisions.authorProfile: web; install npm next, not latest

decision.summary: Author setup explicitly installs npm next into Web. Exact package requires Node >=24.11; CI pins 24.11.0. Large WASM/editor assets may exceed scanner budgets; an incomplete artifact inspection is not a plugin vulnerability or a compatibility pass.

Exact package/setup require Node >=22.19 and declare Web. Release CI configures Node 22; no explicit author preference was found. Spreadsheet usefulness and credential-dependent integrations are outside this compatibility review.
